main.summary: Controls durable deletion-job leader identity, polling, and bounded retry scheduling.

field.name: LeaderLockName
field.summary: Stable PostgreSQL advisory-lock name used to elect one deletion leader.

property.name: PollingInterval
property.summary: Delay between completed scans of due deletion jobs by the elected leader.

property.name: LeaderRetryInterval
property.summary: Gets or sets the maximum randomized delay before a follower retries acquiring deletion leadership.

property.name: InitialJitterMaximum
property.summary: Maximum random delay before the first deletion scan.

property.name: CycleJitterMaximum
property.summary: Maximum random delay added after each deletion scan.

property.name: RetryBaseDelay
property.summary: Base delay used to calculate bounded exponential retry backoff.

property.name: MaximumRetryDelay
property.summary: Maximum delay between retry attempts, including jitter.

property.name: CandidatePageSize
property.summary: Maximum number of due deletion jobs loaded per scan.
